Q: What is the main reason for your score? A: I paid my landlord ₦60,000 and PayNest debited me, the landlord says nothing came in. No reversal, no update. Money left my account for a transfer that failed and it has not returned. This is the second time this is happening to me.

My transfer to Opay shows successful on my side but the receiver has not gotten the money after 14 days. Transfer failed but my balance was still deducted. The status just says 'pending' and nothing has been reversed.

issues.title: Customer Care Hold Times, Chat Queue Timeouts & Ticket Disconnects
issues.description: Customers experience long telephone hold times, live chat timeouts, bot loops, and tickets closed without resolving the reported problem.
representative_comments: Q: What is the main reason for your score? A: I am not happy with the service.
Hello PayNest Team, This is really frustrating. The live chat says an agent will join shortly. I waited 30 minutes and it timed out. I would appreciate a prompt resolution. Regards, Yetunde Alabo

Subject: No response from support for several days | Priority: High | Description: This is really frustrating. Support gave me a generic answer that had nothing to do with my complaint, then closed my ticket without solving anything.

issues.title: SMS OTP Delivery Failures on Carrier Networks & KYC Verification Delays
issues.description: Critical authentication barrier where SMS verification codes fail to deliver across telecom carriers (MTN, Airtel), and KYC identity document verification takes days.
representative_comments: Subject: OTP not received during login | Priority: Urgent | Description: Honestly I am tired. Cannot log in because the SMS code is not delivered. I have tried on MTN and Airtel lines.

Subject: KYC verification pending for too long | Priority: Low | Description: Honestly I am tired. I submitted my NIN and selfie 4 days ago and my account is still under review. I can't do anything with the account.

Hello PayNest Team, Honestly I am tired. The OTP never comes when I try to log in. I request it again and again and it arrives after 30 minutes when it has already expired. I would appreciate a prompt resolution. Regards, Joy Adebayo

issues.title: Payment Card Declines at Online Merchant Checkouts & Point of Sale
issues.description: Virtual and debit cards being rejected during online subscription checkouts (Netflix, Spotify) or POS terminals despite sufficient available funds.
representative_comments: Subject: Virtual card declined at checkout | Priority: Normal | Description: Honestly I am tired. Card payments are unreliable. Half the time it declines and support cannot tell me why.
Interviewer note: Participant (Retail, 14 months) said: "My PayNest card keeps getting declined at online checkout even though I have enough balance."
Tried paying for a subscription with the card three times, all declined, but the money was still held.

issues.title: Undisclosed Withdrawal Surcharges & Hidden FX Rate Markups
issues.description: Customers complain about unexpected fee deductions post-transaction without clear upfront disclosure or notification before confirmation.
representative_comments: Subject: Positive feedback | Priority: High | Description: Love the app, transfers are usually fast and the interface is clean. Keep it up!
i only found out about the ₦100 withdrawal fee after the money was gone. show fees before confirming!
